holder-quote: Maughin stared palely at Ksmvr as the [Skirmisher] cheerfully turned to him.
I have obtained the [Skirmisher] class as a result of my reaching Level 20.
Pause! Ksmvr, that’s good enough for today.
Yvlon looked concerned as she glanced at Ksmvr. The Antinium wore no armor; he had forgone it since armor was hard to fit on his body anyways and he was a [Skirmisher], built for speed.
This is Ksmvr, one of my teammates. He’s a—unique member of the Antinium. Ksmvr, this is Captain Kam, leader of the Whistling Bows. She’s a [Bow Rider]. Ksmvr’s our [Skirmisher], Kam.
All we’ve got is Ksmvr. He’s fast, though. [Skirmisher]. And he can jump. Should we put him on the front?
He looked sideways at Ksmvr as he said that. The [Skirmisher] nodded helpfully.
The newly-leveled [Skirmisher] ran like a blur thanks to his [Quick Movement] Skill
Grimalkin gave Ksmvr a long and distasteful look.
Your team has one [Skirmisher], and he has an enchanted dagger, a Ring of Jumping, and the luxury of being Level 20!

Ksmvr. The [Skirmisher] slashed, his shield raised. His shortsword ran through Crelers, his dagger set others on fire. They covered him, biting, tearing at the Antinium. But his carapace was thick. His Ring of Barkskin made his body stronger.
“You have to go, Ksmvr.”

She grabbed the sword, cutting more flesh away. The Creler felt that. It shrieked, and Crelers swarmed over its body, trying to protect it. Ksmvr tore them away. The adult tried to strike the [Skirmisher], it tried to reach Yvlon, but she was too close! She felt its fear and laughed.

Beside her, Ksmvr was slowly and patiently doing the same thing—but to a blade. He wasn’t bothering with repair, though. The Antinium [Skirmisher] was instead polishing the blade, clearing it of debris, blood, and then sharpening it. He had a small whetstone and file and, for a reason that had puzzled the [Hostess] who’d brought it to him, a very fine bit of sandpaper.
Ceria looked around. Ksmvr stepped forwards. The [Skirmisher] bowed slightly.
The half-Elf smiled. Everyone turned to Ksmvr and Yvlon. The [Skirmisher] waved one hand helpfully.
“I have my arms. I’ll live with them changing. What do you think, Ksmvr?”
Bird. The Worker rammed into Ksmvr, knocking the [Skirmisher] back. But true to his new Skills, Ksmvr just caught himself. He backed up as Bird attacked, all four arms swinging wildly.

They gently pried Bird away from the [Skirmisher]. He flailed at them. Then, abruptly, he sat down and curled up. Bird turned into a ball, ducking his head down, immobile. Much like Pawn once had. Erin hesitated.
The Worker turned and gazed at Ksmvr. The [Skirmisher] hesitated, but then he nodded. Yvlon was checking his bandages.

That was why Yvlon turned to Ksmvr. The [Skirmisher] was tense; she could see his three hands hovering around his weapons. So the [Wounded Warrior] reached out and put an arm around Ksmvr’s shoulders. He started; Yvlon squeezed. She could feel the sensation vaguely, but parts of her arm were—numb. She smiled at him.
Pisces and Ceria turned to Ksmvr. The [Skirmisher] returned the look blankly.
The Antinium [Skirmisher] hesitated. Yvlon grabbed his shoulder.
A piercing tendril shot towards where the Antinium had been, trying to skewer him.
Ulinde tried to step left, but Ksmvr pulled, and she froze.
The Antinium [Skirmisher] thought about this.
I am Ksmvr, formerly of the Free Antinium.
“Ksmvr, secure that wine!”
“Ksmvr, secure that wine!”
effect-quote: the [Skirmisher] moved with all the Skills afforded to him and a Prognugator’s reflexes. He was as fast as a horse for a second.

holder-quote: Ksmvr? He just stared.
Kevin waved at Ksmvr. The [Skirmisher]’s head rose, confused. He looked at Ceria, who was getting her own looks from Troydel—known as ‘Troy’, and Leon.
Ksmvr’s team stared at him as the [Skirmisher] sat back, satisfied.
Ceria spluttered. The half-Elf was red to her pointed ear tips. Pisces was starting to laugh into his robes and Ceria tried to kick him over the side of the wagon. Ksmvr looked very concerned.
Everyone in the world saw Pisces kicking the ball. Bevussa dove for it, but an Antinium leapt. Ksmvr made Bevussa recoil as the [Skirmisher] kicked at the ball.

Ksmvr flew upwards, Forceshield raised. He slashed with his dagger and shortsword as the swarm turned on him. He landed on a moth, crushing its back, leapt again. He landed and ran left, dodging the moths swarming around him.
The [Necromancer] felt Ksmvr land with a thump as the Antinium hopped down. Ksmvr saw Pisces’ snack.

“The burdens weigh heavily, Captain Ceria. I have been plagued by fears of beavers, termites, and other calamities striking my tree last night. Yet I find the rewards to be fruitful. Here is your egg. Thank you for the ice.”
Shallel nodded approvingly as Pisces, Ceria, and Ksmvr exchanged looks. The Antinium [Skirmisher] raised one tentative hand.
Pisces murmured. Ksmvr’s head turned. He opened and closed his mandibles, but the [Necromancer] answered the question before the [Skirmisher] could.
“You sound sure, Ksmvr.”
The half-Elf swore mildly. It didn’t occur to Ksmvr that he might make the problem worse by offering a friendly hand.
Pisces and Ceria stood together and watched Ksmvr join the second wave. The [Skirmisher] leapt over the roof of a building, drawing an arrow, loosing it, even as he vanished.
They never caught him. The [Skirmisher] ran faster than they could.
Ksmvr stepped back, keeping out of range as the huge undead swung, missing the nimbler [Skirmisher].

They couldn’t do the same for the rooftops where Ksmvr was fighting alone. The adventurers began firing downwards, securing their position. Halrac loosed another arrow, supporting the adventurers on the ground. But he was watching Ksmvr fight.
Taking comfort from that, Ksmvr heaved and the skeleton fell away. Yet the press on him didn’t let up. He tried to get up and they dragged him down, by the cloak he wore.
Ksmvr landed on the first Lich’s head. He fired all three crossbows point-blank into the second. Zenol saw him fling something.
“We promised. Maybe we should let someone stay. Ksmvr…”
Ksmvr tried to shove Yvlon onto Pisces’ shoulder.
Ksmvr grabbed the shortsword and Forceshield. He studied the other frozen people.
The [Skirmisher] couldn’t even touch the thing without being corrupted.
It insulted Ksmvr.
Ksmvr bounced, rolled to his feet.
Ksmvr had barely leapt away
Ksmvr didn’t move.
Domehead was aware of what the Antinium was trying to do.
Domehead knocked Ksmvr down.
It couldn’t hit Ksmvr, not with one arm, no matter how it swung.
Ksmvr looked up into the smiling face.
No one was bothering him, so Ksmvr lifted Yinah up.
Ksmvr froze, looked up—and saw Femithain, Armsmaster Dellic, the [Golem Artificers], and two incurious Golems all standing there.
Ksmvr stared at the opening, but that wasn’t where the sound was coming from. He glanced out and saw someone on the balcony.
The Magus-Crafter saw the Antinium [Skirmisher] open and close his mandibles.
he was a [Skirmisher] over Level 30, and had Antinium biology designed to weather most extremes.
Rémi’s camera whirled, and he saw Ksmvr move, leaping, diving—a [Skirmisher] at his fastest.
Ksmvr, Gold-rank adventurer. Ksmvr the [Skirmisher], if you referred to his class.

“I am a [Skirmisher], I have plentiful stamina potions, and I am Antinium. We have marched for days on end without rest. It is what we were designed to do. Moreover, as a law-abiding adventurer, stealing a Golem Horse would be considered theft of a national treasure.”
That was all Ksmvr said. She was watching him shut down in front of her. Why? He had seemed to hydrate and he was a Level 30 [Skirmisher]! What was…?
I am a Gold-rank adventurer. I am deficient. You outmatched me even in speed, which as a [Skirmisher], I should excel at.
The [Skirmisher] nodded calmly.

It was not for the Magus-Crafter to know what lay in Ksmvr’s heart. The [Skirmisher] felt that he had sufficiently impressed the party guests, and Crafter Se had told him privately she ‘forgave him’ for damaging Domehead since it wasn’t his fault.
Why? For enjoying yourself one night, Ksmvr?
So how does an Antinium of Rhir come here? I cannot imagine the First Crafter of Elbe was so careless. I have heard of you, Ksmvr of Izril.
the [Skirmisher] was able to avoid their gazes quite easily
Ksmvr watched the Golem, now nine feet of death, holding the battleaxe, the only source of bright light in the arena.
not chasing a single Antinium [Skirmisher] on horseback.
Ksmvr would move fast on his feet, anyways.
The [Empress of Beasts] returned Ksmvr’s glare.
Ksmvr. Ksmvr of the Horns of Hammerad. [Skirmisher]. Prognugator of the Free Antinium, exceptionally interesting, probably in a relationship with Yvlon Byres.
“The second is an Antinium. Ksmvr. Our [Skirmisher]. A brave, commendably loyal fellow. Very skilled with all weapons. Young.”
Nsiia stopped and let go of Ksmvr. The Antinium [Skirmisher] turned.
The [Skirmisher] spun. He drew his sword in a flash, and a beautiful glow, like the sunrise, illuminated Tiqr’s camps.
Nsiia turned. The [Skirmisher] checked his sword. The glow of the [Paladin]’s blade illuminated his chitin.
Only when Ksmvr stepped forward did he copy the Antinium. The [Skirmisher] saw the man eying the longsword.
He was a [Skirmisher]. Ksmvr was so fast that Pisces had to use [Flash Step] just to keep up with his mobility.
Domehead, walking by Ksmvr, turned, as the Empress of Beasts placed her arm on Ksmvr’s shoulder.
Ksmvr leaned on Spitty as the camel glanced at him
The Antinium [Skirmisher] had inherited it.
I see why Loquea Dree favors him. A [Skirmisher] who picks his battles.
The [Skirmisher] stared at Shurein.
Ksmvr edged back, but Klbkch folded his arms.
Ksmvr! Ksmvr! What are you doing?
Ksmvr landed next to Yvlon and cut an arrow out of the sky
and Ksmvr got up. So famous even Fraerlings knew his name. Pisces was smiling for Ksmvr, but the Antinium [Skirmisher] turned.
Gershal gave Ksmvr a bug-eyed look, which the [Skirmisher] returned
Ksmvr placed a hand on her shoulder solemnly.
He halted and patted Ksmvr on the shoulder
oh, there you are, Ksmvr!
Ksmvr was the most logical choice for leather armor. As a [Skirmisher]
Ksmvr tried to heave with all his strength as Vofea desperately locked her hooves against the railing
The [Skirmisher]’s blades were cutting the air, two of them, performing his signature whirl of blades.
Ksmvr seized her shoulder. The [Skirmisher] might have had weaker theology
All the [Skirmisher] knew was that his class was very useful after all.
Ksmvr of Chandrar, Antinium [Skirmisher]
Ksmvr peered at Typhenous. He was heading straight for Symphony. Revi drew in a breath to shout at the [Skirmisher]
Then again, he was a [Skirmisher], and she would never say anything bad about him.
